newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's IDC probes second steel mill - paper.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's IDC probes second steel mill - paper.

text.p: South Africa's Industrial Development Corporation (IDC) is investigating a new 520 million rand steel rolling mill to add value to part of the output from the Saldanha Steel project, Business Day newspaper said on Thursday.
The IDC is seen entering into a joint venture with Dorbyl Ltd's Baldwin Steel and Swiss steel trader Duferco, the paper said.

The new mill, also to be built at Saldanha Bay, will process about a third of the steel from Saldanha Steel, an IDC-Iscor Ltd joint venture which is expected to be operational in the first quarter of 1998.
Planned annual output for the new mill is about 400,000 tonnes a year, Business Day said.
